title: Dual spatio-functional control of a fission yeast-based bioprocessor upon chemical induction
content:

A chemically inducible fission yeast “bioprocessor” responds to synthetic P-factor by producing a therapeutic protein and hydrophobic agglutinines, enabling controlled functional output and targeted surface adhesion.
